name: B10-0558/2025 – Recital N – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text: N. whereas many women are forced to travel across borders to access abortion care in another EU country, often facing financial, logistical and psychological barriers; whereas the existence of EU rules on cross-border healthcare respects the principle of subsidiarity;
